attributes.board_name: Maine State Board of Examiners of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved activities (pre-approved sponsors/providers or specifically approved): seminars, conferences, interactive/distance learning, commercial self-study; also graduate courses, publications, literature review (max 10), supervised advanced training, development of presentations (max 10) or academic courses (max 10)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Requirement begins with the licensee's second renewal application for an even-numbered year.
rules.audit_note: Attestation subject to audit under DPFR Chapter 13 (Uniform Rule for Substantiation of CE); keep certificates.
rules.notes: Attest on even-year renewals (licenses expire April 30) to 40 h in the preceding two years; at least 20 h in current or anticipated practice areas. No credit for association office, board membership or teaching time. Hardship deferment possible.
